statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Researching, gathering and interpreting information from direct experiences, observations, memory, imagination and a range of traditional and digital sources

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Developing an appreciation of the work of artists, designers and craft workers from their own and other cultures, past and present

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Investigate the past and its impact on our world today through an understanding of: (a) different perspectives and interpretations (b) cause and effect (c) continuity and change (d) progression and regression

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: And by developing: (a) the enquiry skills to undertake historical investigations (b) critical thinking skills to evaluate a range of evidence and appreciate different interpretations (c) creative thinking skills in their approach to solving problems and making decisions (d) chronological awareness and the ability to make connections between historical periods, events and turning points (e) an ability to challenge stereotypical, biased or distorted viewpoints with appropriately sensitive, informed and balanced responses

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Through a broad and balanced range of: (a) historical periods (b) Irish, British, European and global contexts (c) significant political, social, economic, cultural and religious development.

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Develop geographical skills to interpret spatial patterns including atlas and map-work skills

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Develop enquiry and fieldwork skills-questioning, planning, collecting, recording, presenting, analysing, interpreting information and drawing conclusions relating to a range of primary and secondary sources

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Develop critical and creative thinking skills to solve geographical problems and make informed decisions

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: Develop a sense of place through the study of: (a) a range of local, national, European and global contexts (b) contrasting physical and human environments (c) issues of topical significance

statements.subject: Environment and Society
statements.text: In order to develop an understanding of: (a) physical processes of landscape development (b) the interrelationships between physical and human environments (c) the dynamic nature of physical and human environments (d) the ways in which places are interdependent (e) the need for social, economic and environmental change to be sustainable.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy
statements.text: Describe different types of work and investigate the range of employment in the local area, including any changes in employment trends, taking account of the implications for career planning.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy
statements.text: Investigate the local impact of the global market.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy
statements.text: Investigate how technology is affecting life and work.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Employability: Work in the Local and Global Economy

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Assess personal skills and achievements to date; identify areas of interest and set targets for self-improvement.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the changing concept of career.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Engage in the personal career planning process to investigate and reach decisions about post-14 options, recognising that attitudes to work will change over time and are influenced by family and community values.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Practise presentational and self-marketing skills.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate a variety of both familiar and unfamiliar jobs.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Make use of appropriate information, advice and guidance to inform career management.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Identify and practise the skills and attributes which make one enterprising.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Understand the importance of innovation and develop strategies to promote an entrepreneurial spirit, considering possible implications for career planning.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Find out what makes an entrepreneur and develop an awareness of the challenges and benefits of building your own business.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the range of small businesses in the life of the community and consider possible implications for career planning.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Diversity and Inclusion
statements.text: Investigate factors that influence individual and group identity.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Diversity and Inclusion
statements.text: Investigate ways in which individuals and groups express their identity.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Diversity and Inclusion
statements.text: Investigate how and why conflict, including prejudice, stereotyping, sectarianism and racism may arise in the community.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Diversity and Inclusion
statements.text: Investigate ways of managing conflict and promoting community relations, reconciliation.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Human Rights and Social Responsibility
statements.text: Investigate why it is important to uphold human rights standards in modern democratic societies, including meeting basic needs, protecting individuals and groups of people.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Human Rights and Social Responsibility
statements.text: Investigate key human rights principles

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Human Rights and Social Responsibility
statements.text: Investigate why different rights must be limited or balanced in our society.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Human Rights and Social Responsibility
statements.text: Investigate local and global scenarios where human rights have been seriously infringed.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Equality and Social Justice
statements.text: Explore how inequalities can arise in society including how and why some people may experience inequality or discrimination on the basis of their group identity.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Equality and Social Justice
statements.text: Investigate how and why some people may experience inequality/social exclusion on the basis of their material circumstances in local and global contexts.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Equality and Social Justice
statements.text: Explore the work of inter-governmental, governmental and non governmental organisations (NGO) which aim to promote equality and social justice.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Democracy and Active Participation
statements.text: Investigate the basic characteristics of democracy.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Democracy and Active Participation
statements.text: Investigate various ways to participate in school and society.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Democracy and Active Participation
statements.text: Investigate why rules and laws are needed, how they are enforced and how breaches of the law affect the community.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Local and Global Citizenship: Democracy and Active Participation
statements.text: Investigate an issue from a range of viewpoints and suggest action that might be taken to improve or resolve the situation.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore and express a sense of self.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore personal morals, values and beliefs.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the influences on a young person.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the different ways to develop self-esteem.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop skills and strategies to improve own learning.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Receive training in (i) cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR); and (ii) automatic external defibrillator (AED) awareness.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the concept of Health as the development of a whole person.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the influences on physical and emotional /mental personal health.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop understanding about, and strategies to manage, the effects of change on body, mind and behaviour.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the effects on the body of legal and illegal substances and the risks and consequences of their misuse.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop preventative strategies in relation to accidents in the home, school and on the road.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop strategies to promote personal safety.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the qualities of relationships including friendship.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the qualities of a loving, respectful relationship.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop coping strategies to deal with challenging relationship scenarios.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop strategies to avoid and resolve conflict.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the implications of sexual maturation.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore the emotional, social and moral implications of early sexual activity.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Receive age-appropriate, comprehensive and scientifically accurate education on sexual and reproductive health and rights covering prevention of early pregnancy and access to abortion.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop practical skills in the safe, hygienic, healthy and creative use of foods to plan, prepare, cook and serve a range of meals.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop the practical skills in the safe use of a range of utensils and appliances in the preparation, cooking and serving of a variety of dishes.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate the impact of storage, preparation and cooking on food.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Explore ways to achieve a healthy diet.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work

statements.text: Explore the roles and responsibilities of individuals within a variety of home and family structures.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Home Economics: Home and Family Life
statements.text: Develop awareness of parenting skills.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Home Economics: Home and Family Life
statements.text: Investigate some of the changing needs of family members at different stages of the life cycle.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.strand: Home Economics: Home and Family Life
statements.text: Explore strategies to manage family scenarios.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Develop a range of skills to promote independence through planning, managing and using resources.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate a range of factors that influence consumer choices and decisions.

statements.subject: Learning for Life and Work
statements.text: Investigate consumer rights, responsibilities and support available in a range of scenarios.

statements.subject: Physical Education

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Practise, refine and develop skills and specific techniques and use these with consistency

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Experience, monitor and understand a range of short-term effects of exercise on the body systems including cardiovascular and musculo-skeletal systems

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Monitor and evaluate their own activity levels over a period of time and plan how they can fulfil the activity recommendations for health

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Develop their knowledge of safe practices and procedures when taking part in sport and physical activity

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Develop the skills and capabilities required to analyse and improve their own and others’ work

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Develop the skills and capabilities required to work effectively with others in tasks which require co-operation, creativity, problem solving, planning and team work.
